post.originalText:
Claude Opus 5.5 can make an explainer video for your business.

No camera or editor needed.

I went to film school, and the trick is to direct it. Give it the scenes, the length and the pace.

Here's the prompt:

"Adopt the role of an expert motion designer. Build a 30-second animated explainer for my business as a single HTML page. 5 scenes. The customer's problem, what I do, how it works in 3 steps, one proof point, and my name at the end. Bold text, smooth transitions, my brand colours. My business [DESCRIBE WHAT YOU SELL, WHO IT'S FOR AND YOUR COLOURS]"

Claude plays it in the chat. Screen-record it and you've got a video for your site, pitch deck or socials.

Then give notes one at a time. "Slower." "More energy." "Add a scene about pricing."

Save this for your next launch.
